rationale: Owner decision 2026-08-27: interview-prep-prod replaces interview-prep in the build set. Brief transcribed from the repo's own approved docs/spec/productionalization-v1.md (2026-07-06) and docs/intent/productionalization.md; nothing invented.

purpose.after: The productionalized, template/instance-split version of the interview-prep job-search workspace: deterministic tool layer, behavior-contract evals, traced skill runs, and conversational onboarding, with all personal data isolated under workspace/.

desired_outcome.after: A friend can clone the repo, self-onboard through the interview skill, run jd-to-ready on a real JD, and debug any output by following the trace from output to skill to prompt to source file - every skill has a behavior contract verified by deterministic evaluators, so prompts and tools can be loop-engineered against evals.

after: every orchestrator and primitive skill run emits a structured trace (JSONL plus rendered run report) tying each action to a reason and the prompt or file that produced it

every pipeline skill the friend test exercises (intake classify tailor-resume apply-packet find-contacts enrich-contacts verify-emails write-outreach) has evals/<skill>/contract.md and a deterministic verifier runnable with python3 evals/run_eval.py <skill> in an isolated clone
mechanical steps (parsing dedupe file placement naming state markers verification) are deterministic scripts under scripts/ rather than LLM reasoning
the three scheduled systems (Mac launchd linkedin-mcp cloud drip-runner routine PC runner) are declared under infra/ with setup docs and a documented manual-invocation equivalent
/onboard builds a new user canonical files from templates/ and profile.yaml with no hardcoded Kanu paths and python3 scripts/verify_setup.py passes
python3 -m pytest scripts/ is green from a clean checkout
no non-Claude harness support beyond architecture discipline
no public GitHub release or history rewrite - that is a later clean-history export
no changes to the live interview-prep instance on its main branch
no automated sending - every outward action keeps a human gate
no state database - state is read from files that already exist
no new runtime dependencies without owner approval (reportlab is the existing exception)
workspace/** holds all personal and instance data and requires the personal_data change class
LinkedIn MCP setup is required at onboarding and must be guided and verifiable
evals run only in throwaway clones - the real workspace is never touched and git status must show changes only under the clone
determinism-first - justify any step implemented as LLM reasoning instead of a tool
the repo has been frozen since 2026-08-02 - re-verify the spec five workstreams against the tree before planning

next_action.description.after: Read the first build-run digest for interview-prep-prod and decide the first proposals it files
